 Meantime, experienced quick Taneale Peschel could face her former side after being added to the 13-player squad, which otherwise remains unchanged.
 The undefeated Scorchers are targeting a fifth successive victory after three important wins in Melbourne and Sydney last week. 
 Having returned from their longest road trip of the season, Becky Grundy’s team will enjoy the home comforts of the west coast for the week, before taking on Hobart Hurricanes in Queensland (Thursday 19 November) and Sydney Sixers in Sydney (Saturday 21 November) in quick succession. 
 Tomorrow’s match begins at 4:10pm AWST and will be broadcast on Kayo Cricket and ABC Sport.
